mapper.sql: ar_schedules.id AS id, branches.name AS branchName, branches.id AS branchId, CONCAT(ar_schedules.start_date, ' ', ar_schedules.start_time ) AS startDate, CONCAT(ar_schedules.end_date, ' ', ar_schedules.end_time ) AS endDate, ar_schedules.title AS title, ar_schedules.backgroundColor AS backgroundColor, ar_schedules.privacy AS privacy, DATE_FORMAT(ar_schedules.created, '%d-%b-%y %h:%i') AS createdDate, DATE_FORMAT(ar_schedules.modified, '%d-%b-%y %h:%i') AS modifiedDate, CONCAT(users1.first_name, ' ', users1.last_name ) AS createdBy, CONCAT(users2.first_name, ' ', users2.last_name ) AS modifiedBy

FROM ar_schedules LEFT JOIN branches ON branches.id = ar_schedules.branch_id LEFT JOIN users AS users1 ON users1.id = ar_schedules.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS users2 ON users2.id = ar_schedules.modified_by

WHERE ar_schedules.is_active = 1
AND ar_schedules.start_date >= DATE(#{filter.dateFrom})
AND ar_schedules.start_date <= DATE(#{filter.dateTo})
AND (sales_orders.so_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.searchText}, '%'))
mapper.select: SELECT sales_orders.id AS id, sales_orders.so_code AS name, (sales_orders.balance) AS amountDue, (SELECT name FROM customers WHERE id = sales_orders.customer_id) AS customerName FROM ar_schedule_details LEFT JOIN sales_orders ON sales_orders.id = ar_schedule_details.sales_order_id WHERE ar_schedule_details.ar_schedule_id = #{arScheduleId} AND ar_schedule_details.is_active = 1 LIMIT 1;
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ar_schedules( branch_id, start_date, start_time, end_date, end_time, title, backgroundColor, privacy, created, created_by, is_active ) VALUES ( #{arSchedule.branchId}, #{arSchedule.startDate}, #{arSchedule.startTime}, #{arSchedule.endDate}, #{arSchedule.endTime}, #{arSchedule.title}, #{arSchedule.backgroundColor}, #{arSchedule.privacy}, NOW(), #{arSchedule.createdBy}, #{arSchedule.isActive} );
INSERT INTO ar_schedule_details (ar_schedule_id, sales_order_id, amount_due) VALUES (#{arScheduleDetails.arScheduleId}, #{arScheduleDetails.salesOrderId}, #{arScheduleDetails.amountDue});
mapper.update: UPDATE ar_schedule_details SET is_active = 2 WHERE ar_schedule_id = #{arScheduleId};

UPDATE ar_schedules SET `branch_id` = #{arSchedule.branchId}, `start_date` = #{arSchedule.startDate}, `end_date` = #{arSchedule.endDate}, `start_time` = #{arSchedule.startTime}, `end_time` = #{arSchedule.endTime}, `title` = #{arSchedule.title}, `backgroundColor` = #{arSchedule.backgroundColor}, `privacy` = #{arSchedule.privacy}, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{arSchedule.modifiedBy} WHERE id = #{arSchedule.id}
